SELECT s.fundingtype 
FROM schools s 
WHERE s.CDSCode IN (
  SELECT cds 
  FROM satscores 
  WHERE sname = 'None' AND dname = 'None' AND cname = 'None' AND enroll12 = 0
) 
AND AVG(scrmath) > 400
SELECT T1.Phone FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T2.AvgScrRead LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    s.school, 
    s AvgScrWrite, 
    s.CDSSchool, 
    s.CDSCommunicationNumber
FROM 
    satscores s
JOIN 
    schools s ON s.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.OpenDate IS NOT NULL AND s.ClosedDate IS NULL AND s.OpenDate > '1991' AND s.ClosedDate < '2000'
ORDER BY 
    s AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT T2.Street, T2.StreetAbr, T2.City, T2.State, T2.MailStreet, T2.MailStrAbr, T2.MailCity, T2.MailZip, T2.MailState, T2.Phone, T2.EXT, T2.Website, T2.OpenDate, T2.ClosedDate, T2.Charter, T2.CharterNum, T2.FundingType, T2.DOC, T2.DOCType, T2.SOC, T2.SOCType, T2.EDOpsCode, T2.EDOpsName, T2.EILCode, T2.EILName, T2.GSoffered, T2.GSserved, T2.Virtual, T2.Magnet, T2.Latitude, T2.Longitude, T2.AdmFName1, T2.AdmLName1, T2.AdmEmail1, T2.AdmFName2, T2.AdmLName2, T2.AdmEmail2, T2.AdmFName3, T2.AdmLName3, T2.AdmEmail3, T2.LastUpdate
FROM (
  SELECT CDSCode, AVG(AvgScrMath) AS MathAverage
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY CDSCode
) AS T2
WHERE MathAverage = ( SELECT MathAverage FROM T2 ORDER BY MathAverage DESC LIMIT 6 )

SELECT s.State, COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS num_enroll
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode
WHERE ss.enrollment12 > 0
GROUP BY s.State
ORDER BY num_enroll DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.name, T2.format 
FROM cards AS T1 
JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.uuid 
WHERE T1.setCode = 'Hour of Devastation'

SELECT T1.convertedManaCost
FROM cards AS T1
JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.id
WHERE T1.layout = 'normal'
AND T1.frameVersion = '2003'
AND T1.colorIdentity = 'black'
AND T2.uuid = '5f8287b1-5bb6-5f4c-ad17-316a40d5bb0c'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.type
FROM cards AS T1
JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
JOIN foreign_data AS T3 ON T2.uuid = T3.uuid
WHERE T2.status = 'Legal' AND T2.format = 'German'

SELECT T1.convertedManaCost AS "Serra Angel", T2.convertedManaCost AS "Shrine Keeper"
FROM cards AS T1
JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.uuid
WHERE T2.format = 'Commander' AND T2.status = 'Legal'

FROM cards 
WHERE convertedManaCost > 5 AND power != '*'

FROM legalities 
WHERE format = 'Ice Age' AND uuid = '5f8287b1-5bb6-5f4c-ad17-316a40d5bb0c'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
WHERE format = 'premodern' 
AND side IS NULL 
AND flavorText LIKE '%triggered mana ability%'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN borderColor = 'borderless' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) AS percentage

SELECT T2.language
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.id = l.uuid
JOIN foreign_data fd ON l.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE fd.id = 180 AND T2.format = 'Ravnica'

SELECT T1.TagName 
FROM posts p 
JOIN tags T1 ON p.Id = T1.ExcerptPostId 
WHERE p.OwnerUserId = ( SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Reputation = 0 ) 
AND T1.Count = 0

SELECT T1.DisplayName, T1.Reputation
FROM posts P
JOIN users U ON P.OwnerUserId = U.Id
JOIN tags T1 ON T1.ExcerptPostId = P.ExcerptPostId
JOIN tags T2 ON T2.Id = T1.TagName
WHERE T1.TagName = 'Understanding what Dassault iSight is doing'
SELECT COUNT(ViewCount) FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer'

SELECT p.Body 
FROM posts p 
JOIN tags t ON p.Id = t.ExcerptPostId 
WHERE t.TagName = 'bayesian'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Id = 6347
SELECT T2.Text FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Score = 17

SELECT T3.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1
JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.ExcerptPostId
JOIN users AS T3 ON T3.Id = T1.OwnerUserId
WHERE T1.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

SELECT T1.Segment, T1.CostIncrease, T1.PercentageIncrease
FROM (
  SELECT T1.Segment, T1.CostIncrease, T1.PercentageIncrease,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1.Segment ORDER BY T1.CostIncrease DESC) AS RN
  FROM yearmonth AS T1
) AS T2
WHERE T2.RN = 1
AND T1.CostIncrease > 0
AND T1.PercentageIncrease < 0
ORDER BY T2.PercentageIncrease DESC, T2.CostIncrease DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k T1
JOIN gasstations T2
ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date LIKE '2013-06%'

SELECT AVG(Consumption) AS AverageMonthlyConsumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
AND Segment = 'SME'

SELECT T3.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.Date = '2012-08-24'
JOIN customers AS T3 ON T3.CustomerID = T1.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Amount = 548.4
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN CustomerID ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME' AND Date = '2012-08-25'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Currency = 'CZK' THEN T1.Amount ELSE 0 END) - 
       SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Currency = 'EUR' THEN T1.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Difference
FROM transactions_1k T1
JOIN yearmonth T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
JOIN customers T3 ON T2.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID
WHERE T3.Segment = 'SME'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.overall_rating > T2.overall_rating THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.overall_rating) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes T1
JOIN Player_Attributes T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.date = '2013-07-12'

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
    COUNT(player_fifa_api_id) * 100 AS left_foot_percentage
FROM 
    Player_Attributes
WHERE 
    YEAR(player_fifa_api_id) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'

SELECT AVG(home_team_goal) 
FROM Match 
WHERE season = '2010/2011' AND name = 'Poland'

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes T1
JOIN Player T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
JOIN Player_Attributes T3 ON T3.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
JOIN Player T4 ON T4.player_api_id = T3.player_api_id
WHERE T1.height > 180
ORDER BY AVG(T1.heading_accuracy) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes T1
JOIN Player T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow' THEN 'Slow'
        WHEN buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Balanced' THEN 'Balanced'
        ELSE 'Fast'
    END AS speed_class
FROM 
    Team_Attributes
WHERE 
    team_api_id = 9930

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' 
AND attacking_work_rate = 'low'

SELECT team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed BETWEEN 50 AND 60

SELECT T1.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.date) = '2011' AND T1.id = (SELECT id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = '218353')

SELECT T2.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.birthday LIKE '%1970%' AND T2.birthday LIKE '%10%'

SELECT 
    d.district_id, 
    d.A2, 
    d.A3, 
    d.A4, 
    d.A5, 
    d.A6, 
    d.A7, 
    d.A8, 
    d.A9, 
    d.A10, 
    d.A11, 
    d.A12, 
    d.A13, 
    d.A14, 
    d.A15, 
    d.A16, 
    COALESCE(u.unemployment_rate_1996, u.unemployment_rate_1995) AS unemployment_rate_1996, 
    COALESCE(u.unemployment_rate_1996, u.unemployment_rate_1995) - COALESCE(u.unemployment_rate_1995, 0) AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM 
    district d
JOIN 
    loan l ON d.district_id = l.account_id
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON a.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    loan_contract lc ON c.client_id = lc.client_id
JOIN 
    loan_status ls ON lc.contract_id = ls.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l2 ON ls.loan_id = l2.loan_id
JOIN 
    loan l3 ON ls2.contract_id = l3.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l4 ON ls3.contract_id = l4.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l5 ON ls4.contract_id = l5.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l6 ON ls5.contract_id = l6.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l7 ON ls6.contract_id = l7.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l8 ON ls7.contract_id = l8.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l9 ON ls8.contract_id = l9.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l10 ON ls9.contract_id = l10.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l11 ON ls10.contract_id = l11.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l12 ON ls11.contract_id = l12.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l13 ON ls12.contract_id = l13.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l14 ON ls13.contract_id = l14.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l15 ON ls14.contract_id = l15.contract_id
JOIN 
    loan l16 ON ls15.contract_id = l16.contract_id

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM client AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
JOIN loan AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN `order` AS T4 ON T2.account_id = T4.account_id
JOIN trans AS T5 ON T2.account_id = T5.account_id
JOIN district AS T6 ON T2.district_id = T6.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND T1.birth_date < T6.A11
ORDER BY T1.birth_date, T6.A11 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.account_id, T2.approved_amount, T2.account_opening_date
FROM loan AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.status = 'APPROVED'
AND T1.duration > 12
AND T2.account_opening_date = '1993-01-01'
ORDER BY T2.approved_amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.account_id) 
FROM account AS T1 
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id 
WHERE T2.A1 = '1' AND T1.status = 'D' AND T1.district_id = 1

SELECT AVG(T1.amount) AS average_amount
FROM loan AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.status = 'D' AND T2.status = 'C'
SELECT T2.A2 FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T1.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

SELECT 
    S.year,
    COALESCE(D.name, 'Unknown') AS driverName,
    COALESCE(S.points, 0) AS points,
    COALESCE(S.points, 0) * 100 / COALESCE(DS.wins, 0) AS completionPercentage
FROM 
    seasons S
JOIN 
    constructorStandings DS ON S.year = DS.year AND S.raceId = DS.raceId
JOIN 
    drivers D ON DS.driverId = D.driverId
WHERE 
    D.nationality = 'Japanese' AND 
    S.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
ORDER BY 
    S.year, D.name

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname 
FROM drivers AS T1
JOIN constructorStandings AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
JOIN constructorResults AS T3 ON T2.constructorId = T3.constructorId
JOIN races AS T4 ON T3.raceId = T4.raceId
JOIN lapTimes AS T5 ON T4.raceId = T5.raceId
WHERE T5.position = 20 AND T5.time = ( SELECT MIN(time) FROM lapTimes ) AND T5.driverId IN (
  SELECT T4.driverId 
  FROM races AS T4
  JOIN constructorStandings AS T5 ON T4.year = T5.year AND T4.circuitId = T5.circuitId AND T5.position = 20
)
ORDER BY T5.position DESC

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname, T1.nationality, MAX(T2.points) AS max_points
FROM drivers AS T1
JOIN constructorResults AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
JOIN constructorStandings AS T3 ON T2.constructorId = T3.constructorId
JOIN seasons AS T4 ON T3.year = T4.year
JOIN races AS T5 ON T4.url = T5.url
JOIN constructorStandings AS T6 ON T5.raceId = T6.raceId
JOIN drivers AS T7 ON T6.driverId = T7.driverId
WHERE T6.wins = (SELECT MAX(wins) FROM constructorStandings)

SELECT T1.positionOrder FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.forename = T2.forename AND T1.surname = T2.surname WHERE T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HAMITON' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HEIDfeld' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HAMITON' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HEIDfeld' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HAMITON' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HEIDfeld' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HAMITON' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HEIDfeld' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HAMITON' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HEIDfeld' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HAMITON' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HEIDfeld' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HAMITON' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HEIDfeld' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HAMITON' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HEIDfeld' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HAMITON' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HEIDfeld' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HAMITON' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HEIDfeld' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HAMITON' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T2.name = 'HEIDfeld' AND T1.forename = 'LEWIS' AND T

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.driverId) 
FROM drivers AS T1 
JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId 
WHERE T2.year = 2008 AND T2.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'

SELECT T1.surname, T1.forename 
FROM drivers AS T1 
JOIN constructorStandings AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId 
JOIN seasons AS T3 ON T2.year = T3.year 
JOIN races AS T4 ON T2.raceId = T4.raceId 
WHERE T4.name = '592' 
AND T2.points > 0 
ORDER BY T2.points DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.name, T2.points
FROM seasons AS T1
JOIN constructorResults AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year
JOIN constructors AS T3 ON T2.constructorId = T3.constructorId
JOIN drivers AS T4 ON T2.constructorId = T4.constructorId
JOIN drivers AS T5 ON T4.driverId = T5.driverId
JOIN races AS T6 ON T2.raceId = T6.raceId
JOIN constructorStandings AS T7 ON T6.raceId = T7.raceId
JOIN driverStandings AS T8 ON T6.raceId = T8.raceId
JOIN lapTimes AS T9 ON T6.raceId = T9.raceId
JOIN pitStops AS T10 ON T6.raceId = T10.raceId
JOIN qualifying AS T11 ON T6.raceId = T11.raceId
WHERE T5.forename = 'Lewis' AND T5.surname = 'Hamilton'

SELECT 
    c.name AS circuitName, 
    c.location, 
    c.lat, 
    c.lng 
FROM 
    circuits c 
JOIN 
    seasons s ON c.circuitId = s.circuitId 
JOIN 
    races r ON s.year = r.year 
JOIN 
    constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId 
JOIN 
    constructorResults cr ON cs.constructorId = cr.constructorId 
JOIN 
    constructorStandings cs2 ON cr.raceId = cs2.raceId 
JOIN 
    constructorStandings cs3 ON cr.constructorId = cs3.constructorId 
JOIN 
    drivers d ON cr.driverId = d.driverId 
JOIN 
    lapTimes lt ON cr.driverId = lt.driverId 
JOIN 
    pitStops ps ON cr.driverId = ps.driverId 
JOIN 
    qualifying q ON cr.driverId = q.driverId 
WHERE 
    c.country = 'Austria' 
ORDER BY 
    c.name
SELECT T2.lat, T2.lng FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN circuits AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T1.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId)
FROM drivers
WHERE dob IS NULL OR dob < '2007-01-01'
SELECT T2.lat, T2.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN constructors AS T2 ON T1.circuitRef = T2.constructorRef WHERE T1.name = 'Silverstone Circuit'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.driverRef
FROM drivers AS T1
JOIN constructors AS T2 ON T1.constructorRef = T2.constructorRef
JOIN seasons AS T3 ON T2.constructorId = T3.year
JOIN races AS T4 ON T3.year = T4.year
JOIN constructorStandings AS T5 ON T4.raceId = T5.raceId
JOIN driverStandings AS T6 ON T5.driverId = T6.driverId
JOIN constructorResults AS T7 ON T5.constructorId = T7.constructorId
JOIN pitStops AS T8 ON T5.driverId = T8.driverId
JOIN qualifying AS T9 ON T5.driverId = T9.driverId
WHERE T2.nationality = 'American'

SELECT T2.name AS referenceName 
FROM races AS T1 
JOIN constructorResults AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId 
JOIN constructors AS T3 ON T2.constructorId = T3.constructorId 
JOIN circuits AS T4 ON T3.constructorRef = T4.circuitRef 
WHERE T4.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T2.amount 
FROM member AS T1 
JOIN expense AS T2 
ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member 
WHERE T2.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies' 
AND T2.cost > 0

SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id) AS num_meetings
FROM attendance AS T1
JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id
WHERE T1.link_to_member > 10 AND T2.type = 'Meeting'

SELECT 
    m.first_name, 
    m.last_name, 
    m.department, 
    m.college
FROM 
    member m
JOIN 
    major m2 ON m.member_id = m2.member_id
JOIN
